description: Use when the user wants Phase 2/3 sample size with a TIME-TO-EVENT primary endpoint — overall survival, PFS, time to first hospitalization, time to progression, time to a CV composite, etc. Choose the test statistic via `model`: 'ph' (default — log-rank under proportional hazards, gsDesign::nSurv / gsSurv), 'maxcombo' (delayed effect / non-proportional hazards via Fleming-Harrington combo), 'rmst' (restricted mean survival to landmark tau), 'milestone' (survival probability at landmark t*), 'wlr' / 'ahr' (weighted log-rank / average HR for GS NPH). Set design_class='group-sequential' for interim analyses with alpha-spending. Always provide control_median + the relevant effect parameter (hazard_ratio for PH; delay_months + post_delay_hr for NPH models). The `operational` block can solve any 0–4 of {accrual_rate, accrual_duration, followup_duration, total_trial_duration} via the events-tied uniroot. For two co-primary TTE endpoints (PFS+OS) use design_co_primary; for nested PD-L1 strata or biomarker subgroup + ITT use design_multi_population.

alpha.description: Type I error rate. For a standard two-sided 0.05 test use 0.025 with sided = 2.

analysis_times.description: Calendar times of k planned analyses (NPH GS); last = study duration.

binding.description: Whether the futility boundary is binding (NPH GS).

comparison.description: Hypothesis type. 'superiority' (default) tests for a difference; 'non-inferiority' requires ni_margin; 'equivalence' requires equiv_margin.

control_hazard_rate.description: Annualized control-arm event rate, in events per patient-year (e.g., 0.025 for a 2.5%/year CVOT control rate). Useful when the trial characterizes the control arm by hazard rather than median time-to-event. Internally converted to median = 12 * log(2) / control_hazard_rate. Mutually exclusive with control_median.

control_median.description: Control-arm median survival (months). Mutually exclusive with control_hazard_rate; supply exactly one.

delay_months.description: Duration of HR=1 period preceding the effect (NPH models).

design_class.description: Design class. 'fixed' = single final analysis; 'group-sequential' = interim looks with alpha-spending. Group-sequential params (k, timing, sfu/sfl, test_type) are ignored when design_class = 'fixed'.

events_calc.description: PH group-sequential only. Selects gsSurv's events-calculation method: 'schoenfeld' (default) matches Schoenfeld + OBF inflation, the regulatory convention; 'lachin-foulkes' is gsSurv's pre-v0.0.13 default (slightly anti-conservative on events, ~3% lower); 'freedman' is conservative-leaning, rarely used. Non-inferiority designs auto-fall-back to lachin-foulkes (Schoenfeld requires hr0 = 1).

hazard_ratio.description: Target HR (PH only). < 1 favors treatment. For NI with hr_null > 1, the assumed true HR is often 1.

k.description: Number of planned analyses including the final one. Integer in [2, 10].

model.description: Survival statistical model. 'ph' = log-rank under proportional hazards (gsDesign::nSurv / gsSurv). 'maxcombo' / 'rmst' / 'milestone' are NPH fixed-sample (gsDesign2::fixed_design_*). 'wlr' / 'ahr' are NPH group-sequential (gsDesign2::gs_design_wlr / gs_design_ahr).

operational.description: Optional operational kernel inputs. Supply any 0-4 of {accrual_rate, accrual_duration, follow_up_duration, total_trial_duration}; the solver fills in the missing values from rate*duration = N and A + F = T (plus target_events for survival). Result is attached as result.operational with audit fields (given, derived). Supply max_n and/or max_duration to surface feasibility warnings rather than silently returning a design that violates user-stated caps.

max_duration.description: Optional total-trial-duration cap (months). Same warning shape as max_n. Useful when the trial has a hard business deadline that the design must respect.

max_n.description: Optional sample-size cap. If the design exceeds it, a structured feasibility_warnings entry is attached to result.operational explaining the over-by-X% gap. Does NOT change the design — the agent uses the warning to suggest tradeoffs (relax effect size, raise the cap, accept reduced power).

power.description: 1 - beta. Targeted power of the test (default 0.9).

reasoning_chain.description: Optional structured citation trail. Each entry: {decision, value, justification, source_type, source_ref?}. design_report() renders this inline; sponsor_confidential entries trigger a redaction prompt.

items.description: One reasoning-chain entry — a single design decision with its provenance. The LLM and user fill the content; the package validates the shape.

decision.description: Short label for the design choice (e.g., 'alpha', 'hazard_ratio').

justification.description: One sentence explaining why this value was chosen.

source_ref.description: Free-text reference (citation, NCT id, internal protocol number). Optional but encouraged for non-default entries.

source_type.description: Provenance tag for a reasoning-chain entry. Drives the design_report redaction prompt (sponsor_confidential entries flagged before sharing).

value.description: The chosen value (numeric, string, or boolean).

sfl.description: Alpha-spending function. OF = O'Brien-Fleming, Pocock = Pocock, HSD = Hwang-Shih-DeCani (needs sfupar), Power = power family (needs sfupar), LDOF / LDPocock = Lan-DeMets approximations (the standard), 'none' disables.

sfu.description: Alpha-spending function. OF = O'Brien-Fleming, Pocock = Pocock, HSD = Hwang-Shih-DeCani (needs sfupar), Power = power family (needs sfupar), LDOF / LDPocock = Lan-DeMets approximations (the standard), 'none' disables.

tau.description: Landmark time for RMST / milestone (months). Defaults to total study duration.

test_type.description: gsDesign test.type. 1 = efficacy-only, 2 = symmetric efficacy+futility, 3 = non-binding futility, 4 = binding futility, 5/6 = same with lower beta-spending.

timing.description: Information fractions at each analysis, length k, strictly increasing in (0,1], last = 1. Defaults to equal spacing 1/k, 2/k, ..., 1.

name: design_survival
